result.topic_en: Ramanujan states transformation formulas under the conditions αβ = π²/4 (and that of his formula (30)) for alternating series of divisor functions σ_s(n) weighted by e^{-nα}, and for series of odd powers divided by cosh nα, with the values expressed through Euler numbers.
result.transcription:
Add Ms a 94$^{18(64)}$ \quad (64)
(31) \quad $\alpha^{r}\left\{\sigma_{2r-1}(1)e^{-\alpha} - \sigma_{2r-1}(3)e^{-3\alpha} + \sigma_{2r-1}(5)e^{-5\alpha} - \cdots\right\}$
$+(-\beta)^{r}\left\{\sigma_{2r-1}(1)e^{-\beta} - \sigma_{2r-1}(3)e^{-3\beta} + \sigma_{2r-1}(5)e^{-5\beta} - \cdots\right\} = 0$
with the same condition as in (30). Again if $\alpha\beta = \pi^2/4$
and $r$ is any positive integer excluding 0, then
(32) \quad $2\alpha^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1^{1-2r}}{\cosh\alpha} - \frac{3^{1-2r}}{\cosh 3\alpha} + \frac{5^{1-2r}}{\cosh 5\alpha} - \cdots\right\}$
$+2(-\beta)^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1^{1-2r}}{\cosh\beta} - \frac{3^{1-2r}}{\cosh 3\beta} + \frac{5^{1-2r}}{\cosh 5\beta} - \cdots\right\}$
$= 4\alpha^{1-r}\left\{\sigma_{1-2r}(1)e^{-\alpha} - \sigma_{1-2r}(3)e^{-3\alpha} + \sigma_{1-2r}(5)e^{-5\alpha} - \cdots\right\}$
$+4(-\beta)^{1-r}\left\{\sigma_{1-2r}(1)e^{-\beta} - \sigma_{1-2r}(3)e^{-3\beta} + \sigma_{1-2r}(5)e^{-5\beta} - \cdots\right\}$
$= \frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac{E_1}{0!}\cdot\frac{E_{2r-1}}{(2r-2)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^{r-1}+\beta^{r-1}\right\} - \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^3\frac{E_3}{2!}\cdot\frac{E_{2r-3}}{(2r-4)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^{r-3}+\beta^{r-3}\right\}$
$+\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^5\frac{E_5}{4!}\cdot\frac{E_{2r-5}}{(2r-6)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^{r-5}+\beta^{r-5}\right\} - \cdots\cdots$
the last term being $(-1)^{\frac{r-1}{2}}\cdot\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{r}\left\{\frac{E_r}{(r-1)!}\right\}^2$ or $(-1)^{\frac{r}{2}}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{r-1}\frac{E_{r-1}}{(r-2)!}\cdot\frac{E_{r+1}}{r!}(\alpha-\beta)$
according as $r$ is odd or even, where $E_1 = 1$, $E_3 = 1$, $E_5 = 5$, ...
the Eulerian numbers. As an example we have when
$r = 1$,
(33) \quad $\left\{\sigma_{-1}(1)e^{-\alpha} - \sigma_{-1}(3)e^{-3\alpha} + \sigma_{-1}(5)e^{-5\alpha} - \cdots\right\}$
$+\left\{\sigma_{-1}(1)e^{-\beta} - \sigma_{-1}(3)e^{-3\beta} + \sigma_{-1}(5)e^{-5\beta} - \cdots\right\} = \frac{\pi}{8}$
with the condition $\alpha\beta = \pi^2/4$

methods.what: Transformation formula: weighted sum of alternating odd-index divisor-function series in α and β vanishes, under the condition of (30)
Transformation formula for series of n^{1-2r}/cosh(nα) with αβ=π²/4, equated to series of σ_{1-2r}(n)e^{-nα} and to a finite sum of products of Euler numbers
Last term of the Euler-number sum, depending on the parity of r
Special case r=1: sum of two alternating σ_{-1} series equals π/8 when αβ=π²/4
